title: The Latest: ‘Everyone Was in the Loop’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，在现场采访一些商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院正式推进弹劾调查。

sentences.en: We are joined this afternoon by Ambassador Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，我们邀请到了戈登·桑德兰大使。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, this morning.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，是今天上午。

sentences.en: It was a long day yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天真是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: So today we saw the most complicated witness in these impeachment hearings to date, Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们见证了这些弹劾听证会迄今为止最复杂的证人——戈登·桑德兰。

sentences.en: I expect that few Americans have heard my name before these events.
sentences.zh: 我预计在这些事情发生之前，很少有美国人听说过我的名字。

sentences.en: This is the Trump donor turned diplomat.
sentences.zh: 这位是由特朗普捐款人转变为外交官的人。

sentences.en: The highest honor in my public life came when President Trump asked me to serve as the United States ambassador to the European Union.
sentences.zh: 当我公共生涯中最高的荣誉到来时，是特朗普总统邀请我担任美国驻欧盟大使。

sentences.en: So right out of the gate in his opening statements, was there a quid pro quo?
sentences.zh: 所以在开场陈述的一开始，到底有没有利益交换？

sentences.en: Sondland is dropping bombs.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰爆出了猛料。

sentences.en: With regard to the requested
sentences.zh: 关于所要求的

sentences.en: White House call and the White House meeting, the answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 白宫通话和白宫会面，答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: He says yes, there was clearly a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 他说是的，显然存在利益交换。

sentences.en: I emailed Secretary Pompeo directly.
sentences.zh: 我直接给蓬佩奥部长发了电子邮件。

sentences.en: Secretary of State Mike Pompeo knew what was going on.
sentences.zh: 国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥对发生的事情心知肚明。

sentences.en: I mentioned to Vice President Pence before the meetings.
sentences.zh: 我在会前向副总统彭斯提及过此事。

sentences.en: Vice President Mike Pence knew what was going on.
sentences.zh: 副总统迈克·蓬佩奥对此事心知肚明。

sentences.en: The suggestion that we were engaged in some irregular or rogue diplomacy is absolutely false.
sentences.zh: 认为我们参与了某种非正常或独断外交的说法是绝对错误的。

sentences.en: And there's really no back channel because everyone was in the loop.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上没有什么暗中渠道，因为所有人都知情。

sentences.en: Everyone was in the loop.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知情。

sentences.en: It was no secret to anyone what was going on.
sentences.zh: 对任何人来说，发生的事情都不是秘密。

sentences.en: And he had the full buy-in of the whole government on this.
sentences.zh: 而且他在这一点上得到了整个政府的全力支持。

sentences.en: Everyone was informed via email on July 19th.
sentences.zh: 7月19日，所有人都通过电子邮件收到了通知。

sentences.en: But the latest is it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 但最新情况是，事情很复杂。

sentences.en: So far in these hearings, we've been getting testimony from career diplomats, former military types who are very formal in their testimony.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，在这些听证会上，我们听取了职业外交官、前军方人士的证词，他们在作证时非常正式。

sentences.en: They're trained to keep notes.
sentences.zh: 他们受过做记录的训练。

sentences.en: They have extemporaneous notes.
sentences.zh: 他们有即兴记录。

sentences.en: They have memos.
sentences.zh: 他们有备忘录。

sentences.en: They have methodical accounts of what happened and documents in some cases to back it up.
sentences.zh: 他们对发生的事情有条理的记录，在某些情况下还有文件来支持。

sentences.en: They've got the receipts, as you might say.
sentences.zh: 正如你可能会说的，他们掌握了证据。

sentences.en: Sondland is a totally different type of character.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰是一个完全不同类型的人物。

sentences.en: You confirmed to President Trump that President Zelensky, quote, loves your ass, unquote.
sentences.zh: 你曾向特朗普总统确认，泽连斯基总统引述说，‘爱你的屁股’。

sentences.en: Do you recall saying that?
sentences.zh: 你还记得说过这话吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it sounds like something I would say.
sentences.zh: 是的，这听起来像我会说的话。

sentences.en: Here he is.
sentences.zh: 他来了。

sentences.en: This guy is a wealthy hotel magnet from Oregon.
sentences.zh: 这家伙是来自俄勒冈州的富有酒店大亨。

sentences.en: He's a political donor.
sentences.zh: 他是一个政治捐款人。

sentences.en: He's new to being a diplomat.
sentences.zh: 他当外交官不久。

sentences.en: And he doesn't have any of those things.
sentences.zh: 而且他完全没有那些东西。

sentences.en: The Democrats lawyer, Dan Goldman, points this out right away.
sentences.zh: 民主党律师丹·戈德曼立刻指出了这一点。

sentences.en: You are not a note taker, right?
sentences.zh: 你不是一个会做笔记的人，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm not a note taker.
sentences.zh: 我不是个做笔记的人。

sentences.en: Never have been.
sentences.zh: 从来都不是。

sentences.en: He doesn't take notes.
sentences.zh: 他不记笔记。

sentences.en: He doesn't have this all written down.
sentences.zh: 他没有把这些都写下来。

sentences.en: He can't really remember some of the conversations that he's being asked about.
sentences.zh: 对于被问及的一些对话，他实在记不太清了。

sentences.en: But certainly based on the additional memory that you have gained over the past few weeks from
sentences.zh: 但可以肯定的是，根据你在过去几周里通过

sentences.en: reading the testimony of others based on their notes and reviewing your own documents, you have remembered a lot more than you did when you were deposed.
sentences.zh: 阅读他人笔记中的证词以及审阅自己的文件而获得的额外记忆，你比作证时记起了更多事情。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh, and also he's contradicted his original closed-door testimony on multiple occasions in the week since he first talked to the House Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 哦，此外，自从他第一次与众议院情报委员会对话以来的这周里，他在多个场合推翻了自己最初的闭门证词。

sentences.en: He started out saying there was no quid pro quo in all of this.
sentences.zh: 他一开始说这一切中根本没有利益交换。

sentences.en: But it turns out when someone else testifies that they heard him describe one, all of a sudden he remembers, yeah, there was one.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，当其他人作证说听到他描述过时，他突然记起来了，是的，确实有过。

sentences.en: He did describe that at one point.
sentences.zh: 他确实在某个时刻描述过这一点。

sentences.en: In short, he's got a credibility problem.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他存在信誉问题。

sentences.en: It's messy.
sentences.zh: 这很棘手。

sentences.en: You freely admit that you, you know, when I asked your deposition, we put together a list of all the times you said you don't recall.
sentences.zh: 你大方地承认，你知道的，当我在你的证词中询问时，我们列出了一份你所有说‘记不清了’的清单。

sentences.en: It's like two pages long.
sentences.zh: 大约有两页纸长。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: Is that all?
sentences.zh: 就这些吗？

sentences.en: So naturally, the Republican lawyer on the Intelligence Committee, Steve Castor, wants to focus on this messiness.
sentences.zh: 因此，情报委员会的共和党律师史蒂夫·卡斯特自然想要关注这种混乱局面。

sentences.en: And when he gets a chance to question Sondland, he does just that.
sentences.zh: 当他有机会质问桑德兰时，他确实这么做了。

sentences.en: On a lot of these questions, I mean, there's nuance, there are ambiguities, and we don't have records, we don't have notes, and we don't have recollections, correct?
sentences.zh: 关于许多这类问题，我的意思是，这里有细微差别，有模棱两可的地方，而且我们没有记录，没有笔记，也没有回忆，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, it's situational things that sort of trigger memory.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是一些情境化的东西在某种程度上触发了记忆。

sentences.en: All of these calls, these meetings with very important people tend to sort of blend together until I have someone that can show me what we discussed, what the subject was,
sentences.zh: 所有这些电话，这些与非常重要人物的会面往往会混淆在一起，直到有人能向我展示我们讨论过什么、主题是什么，

sentences.en: then all of a sudden it comes back.
sentences.zh: 然后它突然就浮现出来了。

sentences.en: I mean, we're trying to get to the facts here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们是在这里试图弄清事实。

sentences.en: We're trying to find out what actually happened, what's reliable, what's accurate.
sentences.zh: 我们试图找出实际发生了什么，什么才是可靠的，什么才是准确的。

sentences.en: You don't have records, you don't have your notes, because you didn't take notes.
sentences.zh: 你没有记录，你没有笔记，因为你没有记笔记。

sentences.en: You don't have a lot of recollections.
sentences.zh: 你没有多少回忆。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the trifecta of unreliability.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是不可靠的三重打击。

sentences.en: Isn't that true?
sentences.zh: 难道不是吗？

sentences.en: Well, what I'm trying to do today is to use the limited information I have to be as forthcoming as possible with you and the rest of the committee.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我今天要做的，就是利用我仅有的信息，尽可能地对你和委员会的其他成员坦诚相告。

sentences.en: And as these recollections have been refreshed by subsequent testimony, by some texts and emails that I've now had access to, I think I filled in a lot of blanks.
sentences.zh: 而且随着后续证词，以及我现在可以查阅的一些短信和电子邮件刷新了这些记忆，我认为我填补了许多空白。

sentences.en: But a lot of it's speculation.
sentences.zh: 但其中很大一部分是推测。

sentences.en: A lot of it is your guess.
sentences.zh: 很大一部分是你的猜测。

sentences.en: And we're talking about, you know, an impeachment of the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的可是，你知道的，弹劾美国总统的事。

sentences.en: So the evidence here ought to be pretty darn good.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的证据应该非常过硬才行。

sentences.en: So outwardly, Ambassador Sondland may seem like a terrible witness for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 因此，从表面上看，桑德兰大使似乎是民主党的一个糟糕证人。

sentences.en: He's imprecise.
sentences.zh: 他不精确。

sentences.en: He's unreliable.
sentences.zh: 他不可靠。

sentences.en: He either doesn't remember things or he doesn't have any proof.
sentences.zh: 他要么记不清事情，要么拿不出任何证据。

sentences.en: But the question in my mind is, might he actually be the most damning witness of all for the Democrats?
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，问题是，他实际上会不会是民主党最具毁灭性的证人？

sentences.en: He's someone who was friendly with the president.
sentences.zh: 他是一个与总统关系友好的人。

sentences.en: He was talking to the Ukrainians on a fairly regular basis.
sentences.zh: 他相当定期地与乌克兰人交谈。

sentences.en: He had an up-close view of all of this.
sentences.zh: 他对这一切有着近距离的观察。

sentences.en: And he's willing to make these definitive statements, reach these big conclusions.
sentences.zh: 而且他愿意做出这些绝对性的陈述，得出这些重大的结论。

sentences.en: Yes, there was a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 是的，存在利益交换。

sentences.en: No, there was no back channel.
sentences.zh: 不，没有暗中渠道。

sentences.en: Everybody knew about this.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道这件事。

sentences.en: So he may not have notes, but does it actually matter?
sentences.zh: 所以他可能没有笔记，但这真的重要吗？

sentences.en: You know, the other thing that was striking about
sentences.zh: 你知道，另一件引人注目的事情

sentences.en: Sondland's testimony was how comfortable he seemed.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰的证词是显得多么镇定。

sentences.en: He seems kind of at ease with the role he's playing in all of this.
sentences.zh: 他对自己在这个事件中所扮演的角色似乎感到某种程度的自在。

sentences.en: He knows who he is.
sentences.zh: 他清楚自己是谁。

sentences.en: He's not a career politician.
sentences.zh: 他不是职业政客。

sentences.en: He's not versed in the
sentences.zh: 他不精通

sentences.en: complicated geopolitics of all of this.
sentences.zh: 这一切复杂的国际地缘政治。

sentences.en: He's just landed in the middle of this situation.
sentences.zh: 他只是恰好落在了这个局面的正中央。

sentences.en: And he says he's playing the hand he was dealt.
sentences.zh: 他说他只是在打手里这副牌。

sentences.en: And that may seem like someone trying to protect himself.
sentences.zh: 这看起来可能像是一个在试图保护自己的人。

sentences.en: Or it could be someone basically trying to come clean.
sentences.zh: 或者它也可能是一个基本上在试图坦白从宽的人。

sentences.en: Maybe he's not reliable, but he may be the most important witness Democrats have.
sentences.zh: 也许他并不可靠，但他可能是民主党拥有的最重要的证人。

sentences.en: Like I said, it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，情况很复杂。

sentences.en: So that's the lateSt. Tomorrow on The Daily, more on how the Democrats and Republicans handled this unusual witness.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新情况。明天在《每日新闻》播客中，将有更多关于民主党和共和党如何应对这位不寻常证人的内容。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《电线切割机秀》节目中，我们正为假日期间的招待做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症、食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方寻找《电线切割机秀》。
